name: Trade Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of executed order.

OFBK.name: Off Order Book Trade
OFBK.definition: Trade that is over the counter.

BKTR.name: Back Up Trade
BKTR.definition: Trade that is input manually in case of issue on the original trade that either was not processed or not received.

COTR.name: Corrective Trade
COTR.definition: Trade that is generated following a corporate action.

LKTR.name: Linked Trade
LKTR.definition: Trades coming from the application of a coorporate event.
